This week, President Donald Trump launched a one-man diplomacy blitz to end
his war with Iran - maybe literally "one-man," because it's unclear if Trump
was negotiating with anyone[ but
himself](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/25/us-talking-to-itself-says-
iran-as-trump-claims-wheels-of-diplomacy-turning).

On Monday morning, just two days after he threatened to bomb Iranian power
plants - a likely [war
crime](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/03/24/us/politics/trump-iran-power-
stations.html) - Trump[ posted](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/23/trump-iran-
war-power-plants-energy-infrastructure-middle-east.html) about "VERY GOOD AND
PRODUCTIVE CONVERSATIONS REGARDING A COMPLETE AND TOTAL RESOLUTION OF OUR
HOSTILITIES," between unnamed American and Iranian negotiators. On Tuesday, he
both tacked on the puzzling[ claim](https://www.foxnews.com/politics/trump-
touts-significant-iran-present-linked-strait-hormuz-deal-talks-heat-up) that
Iran had given him a "very big present," and[ ](https://apnews.com/live/iran-
war-israel-trump-03-25-2026)[reportedly](https://apnews.com/article/iran-us-
israel-trump-lebanon-march-24-2026-8bb5e79a98ea72fccc5c50b4931ad778) sent Iran
a 15-point ceasefire plan similar to US demands already rejected _before_ the
war.

Pakistani intermediaries confirmed they had[
delivered](https://apnews.com/article/iran-us-israel-trump-lebanon-
march-25-2026-be07c54139bcc70672bb33f0773ede6a) Trump's messages to Tehran.
Iranian officials denied talks had taken place - and made [their own
demands](https://www.wsj.com/livecoverage/iran-war-us-israel-news-
updates/card/iran-sets-high-bar-in-cease-fire-talks-here-s-what-tehran-is-
asking-for-zBFbHUSXni4wrMT1AKqY).

Whether or not Tehran has opened Trump's DMs, the sad truth is that Trump's
own actions have made negotiating a peace nearly impossible in the immediate
term. The good news is there's still a lot he can do to speed up the end of
his war. But let's start with what he can't do:
